source: hand-authored fixture for issue #150 — not shipped data
description: A curated entry carrying a WHITESPACE-ONLY alias, the shape issue #150 reports. containsBoundedToken already refuses a token that is empty after the diacritic fold, but a single space is not empty: it is found at every word gap, and the recorded-name rule's two-letter inflection allowance carries the match past the following word's last letters. So the blank alias makes matchesDrugName true for allergen text it has nothing to do with (`Vitamin A, B`), and that entry's contraindication then fires for every patient with any allergy recorded at all. Operator-authored `json` only: the ddinter and atc parsers drop blank aliases as they build them. The second entry is the control — same file, no blank alias, must be untouched.
